title: Enabled bulk commands look disabled and row controls have insufficient contrast
reproduction: On API34, night mode, 1.3x, open a populated directory with zero checks. Compare enabled Subscribe all with disabled Subscribe selected; check one row and compare again. Tap Subscribe all to verify it actually opens confirmation.
expected: Enabled normal text >=4.5:1; row checkbox/active control indicator >=3:1 against adjacent surface; visibly distinct disabled state. Preserve selected tag label.
observed: Signed 13.5.7b 67696502ad871986b739e044b0c6dde3484e5285c28d0702eb36250b11e853d3: healthy enabled flags and real modal despite enabled ink measuring 3.048:1 vs disabled 3.222:1. Checkbox 1.461:1 and off-switch thumb 1.263:1. Independent parent capture 3.048/3.179/1.475/1.260:1. The round row control is a switch, not a radio.
fix: Use Discover-only state lists for action text and row checkbox/switch, contrasting check mark and disabled alpha. No global accent, Home or tag palette changes.
test_evidence: Pixel replay on palette build 41608cf4: enabled 9.624:1, disabled unchanged 3.222:1, checkbox off/on 8.349/8.215:1, switch off thumb 4.523:1; selected tag preserved 4.928:1. Final app 8bd557a12cf5c5176d8c5b0d3c57031bf32c41f181207c2c05d91d246cbd852d / test 076ccb5a5dfb8037d389dff7a8ee4b26187611ef229fc20b04a0be45cb6a4641: enabledBulkActionsAndRowSelectionContrastWithTheirActualSurfaces passed en-US 1.3 day AND night. Physical selection, checked/unchecked pixel assertions and Cancel -> DAO URL absent. Earlier animation-frame test failure retained. See app/build/reports/audit-2026-11-25/deep-bulk/contrast.csv and instrumentation.txt. Not a new signed release or whole-app palette certification.

title: Short LTR syntax overlaps the subscription switch in Hebrew rows
reproduction: Render Discover in he-IL at 1.3x; first row has short LTR name Ads, syntax Hosts. Observe both action targets before/after subscribing. Parent screenshot SHA256 279467835b50a61d99bd6d8a04dd1376b4c4cf85081d8dafe27fd70947af57bc.
expected: Name, syntax and optional status stay between checkbox and switch in either direction; full-width description starts below both controls and metadata.
observed: Pre-layout debug 41608cf40a48c3d296ae8c2486334542aa1779154d97bc51ee87b439565f3f28: actual syntax rect (42,113)-(796,169) intersects switch (42,42)-(179,168) by 137x55 physical pixels at he-IL 1.3. Related AUD-SRC-012 addressed long-label ellipsis; this is a distinct short-text control collision.
fix: Constrain syntax and status to both edges of the title column. Position description under a bottom barrier for both targets, syntax and visible status; retain text wrapping.
test_evidence: Same test APK 076ccb5a5dfb8037d389dff7a8ee4b26187611ef229fc20b04a0be45cb6a4641: shortLtrRowMetadataClearsBothControlsBeforeAndAfterSubscription fails on previous layout; passes on final app 8bd557a12cf5c5176d8c5b0d3c57031bf32c41f181207c2c05d91d246cbd852d at he-IL 1.3 AND 1.6. Rendered locale/font/RTL assertions plus geometry with hidden and visible status; actual switch tap inserts correct URL. See app/build/reports/audit-2026-11-25/deep-bulk/instrumentation.txt. Other devices/locales and signed rebuild not tested.
